description.zh: 燃烧需要可燃物、氧气和达到着火点的温度三者同时具备，灭火就是抽掉其中一条；接触面积与氧气供应决定烧得多快。仅为简化的教学三角模型，数值为近似值。
description.en: Burning needs fuel, oxygen and a temperature at the ignition point together, and putting out a fire means removing one; contact area and oxygen supply set how fast it burns. A simplified teaching model with approximate numbers.

title.en: Why does that way of putting out a fire work?

ask.zh: 燃烧要可燃物、氧气、着火温度三者同时具备——盖上锅盖灭火，是抽掉了哪一条？
ask.en: Burning needs fuel, oxygen and ignition temperature all at once — when you smother a pan fire with a lid, which leg are you removing?

reveal.zh: 盖锅盖隔绝了氧气，三条腿缺了一条，火就灭了；灭火的办法都是抽掉三者之一。
reveal.en: The lid cuts off the oxygen, so one leg of the triangle is gone and the fire dies; every way of putting out a fire removes one of the three.
